decision.changed_angle: Three tickers carry from Nov21, but their current evidence changes the investment questions. The Nov21 MSTR lead focused on asset purchases, scale and zero-interest financing; the Nov22 lead cites the newly published Nov21 Reuters disclosure of Citron's short and Yahoo account of the proxy falling while bitcoin reaches records. That identified opposing position makes the proxy premium the central disagreement, rather than repeating the financing celebration. SNOW adds Nov21 Reuters coverage of its named Anthropic AI relationship alongside its result response, while NVDA moves from immediate earnings expectations to specific Nov21 investor-concentration accounts from MarketWatch and 24/7 Wall St. GAP supplies a new earnings selection. The overlap is therefore retained on distinct dated evidence; the conclusion is not an inference from the latest price moves alone.

supporting_basket_context.scope: Named Anthropic relationship and completed result attention, versus prior earnings/outlook and Datavolo side.
Specific investor concentration accounts, not generalized retail holdings or flows.

decision.rationale: The current RDDT side expressly identifies itself as a carryover and makes no new-company-catalyst claim. It retains eligible Nov22 Bloomberg Advance-borrowing and Investopedia financing-attention headlines used before the Nov25 appearance. Their scope is shareholder financing, not Reddit raising operating cash, a completed sale or a predicted forced liquidation. The late Guardian UK audience article has been removed following original-publication review. The current side is secondary (position3),152whitespace words and160words under the shared gate tokenizer, so a bounded carryover is justified without pretending old evidence is fresh.
